versions.subject: Create a new rule to detect "Create Account"
docs: MITRE ATT&CK(R) trademark references removed or adjusted https://github.com/Neo23x0/sigma/issues/1028
Modifying Creation Of An User Account
versions.detection:
syscall_record_type:
    type: 'SYSCALL'
    exe|endswith: '/useradd'
add_user_record_type:
    type: 'ADD_USER' # it appears that it doesn't require an auditd rule
condition: syscall_record_type or add_user_record_type
